name: Hidetsugu
description: An ogre shaman who allies with Toshi in the Hyozan Reckoners and later merges with the All-Consuming Oni of Chaos.

description_citations.text: "Toshiro Umezawa". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Hidetsugu holds over a dozen oni in blood oath.
timeline.quote: Hidetsugu held over a dozen oni in blood oath.

citation.text: Heartless Hidetsugu (Betrayers of Kamigawa, 2005), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Keiga is killed by Hidetsugu and his yamabushi during their attack on Minamo's school.
timeline.quote: He was killed (if kami can be killed) by Hidetsugu and his yamabushi minions during their attack on the school

citation.text: "Dragon", section "Dragon spirits". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Toshi finds the oni eating Minamo's library and meets Hidetsugu, who wants his full commitment to the Hyozan Reckoners; Toshi refuses and they become enemies.
timeline.quote: knowing they are becoming enemies

citation.text: "Guardian: Saviors of Kamigawa", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Toshi uses Night's Reach's powers to chase off the Oni of Chaos at Minamo, drawing Hidetsugu's ire as Konda's ghost army attacks.
timeline.quote: Luckily at that moment Konda and his ghost army attack Minamo

citation.text: "Guardian: Saviors of Kamigawa", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Hidetsugu reveals the oath kills any who kill without drawing blood and chokes Kiku and Toshi; Marrow-Gnawer stabs Hidetsugu in the eyes, bringing the oath's wrath on himself.
timeline.quote: he saves Toshi and Kiku by stabbing Hidetsugu in the eyes

citation.text: "Guardian: Saviors of Kamigawa", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: O-Kagachi appears; the Oni of Chaos flees, breaking Hidetsugu's spirit, and Toshi mercy kills Marrow-Gnawer.
timeline.quote: Toshi mercy kills Marrow-Gnawer

citation.text: "Guardian: Saviors of Kamigawa", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kyodai summons Hidetsugu, now the new chaos oni, who eats Mochi.
timeline.quote: then Hidetsugu eats Mochi

citation.text: "Guardian: Saviors of Kamigawa", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Hidetsugu plans to raze Minamo and Otawara; Toshi persuades him to attack Jukai first, and they trade items.
timeline.quote: Toshi convinces Hidetsugu that he needs more time and tells him to attack Jukai first.

citation.text: "Heretic: Betrayers of Kamigawa", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Hidetsugu gives the Yuki-Onna plate to Godo, who cracks it at the border with Towabara and she lures soldiers to death.
timeline.quote: The Yuki-Onna starts luring soldiers to their deaths.

citation.text: "Heretic: Betrayers of Kamigawa", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Michiko speaks with Mochi at Minamo, learning what her father took was a daughter of O-Kagachi, as Toshi learns the soratami plan to conquer Kamigawa and Hidetsugu attacks Minamo.
timeline.quote: Then suddenly the academy is rocked as Hidetsugu attacks.

citation.text: "Heretic: Betrayers of Kamigawa", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Hidetsugu's forces kill Keiga; at Eiganjo O-Kagachi bites Yosei in half and Takeno dies protecting Konda; Toshi grabs That Which Was Taken, making O-Kagachi disappear.
timeline.quote: Toshi grabs That Which Was Taken and teleports out, making O-Kagachi disappear.

citation.text: "Heretic: Betrayers of Kamigawa", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Hidetsugu kills Boss Uramon's task force except Toshiro Umezawa, whom he agrees to form the Hyozan Reckoners with.
timeline.quote: Hidetsugu killed all the men except Umezawa

citation.text: "Hidetsugu", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After a long search Hidetsugu finds a worthy apprentice in Kobo.
timeline.quote: he found a worthy apprentice in the ex-budoka Kobo

citation.text: "Hidetsugu", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Hidetsugu and Toshi perform a ritual making Kobo part of the hyozan, and send him to Jukai.
timeline.quote: together they performed the ritual which made Kobo part of the hyozan

citation.text: "Hidetsugu", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kobo is killed by Choryu; Hidetsugu tortures Choryu for months.
timeline.quote: Kobo was killed by the Minamo wizard Choryu

citation.text: "Hidetsugu", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Hidetsugu vows total revenge for Kobo's death and kills yamabushi who refuse to help him.
timeline.quote: Hidetsugu vowed to exact total revenge on anybody responsible for Kobo's death

citation.text: "Hidetsugu", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Hidetsugu assaults Minamo, defeats Keiga, destroys the Academy and summons the All-Consuming Oni of Chaos.
timeline.quote: destroyed the Academy, and killed almost everyone inside

citation.text: "Hidetsugu", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Hidetsugu unleashes his oni army on Otawara, and Toshi declares war on him.
timeline.quote: Toshi openly declared a war between the two founding members of the hyozan

citation.text: "Hidetsugu", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Hidetsugu nearly kills Toshi and Kiku; Marrow-Gnawer stabs his eye and Toshi stabs the other.
timeline.quote: Toshi used Hidetsugu's momentary distraction and stabbed his remaining eye.

citation.text: "Hidetsugu", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: O-Kagachi tears the All-Consuming Oni of Chaos in two, and Hidetsugu asks Toshi to transport him to the oni's honden.
timeline.quote: the oni overlord was almost effortlessly torn in two by O-Kagachi

citation.text: "Hidetsugu", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Hidetsugu returns with restored eyes, merged with the All-Consuming into a being like the Sisters, and consumes Mochi.
timeline.quote: tearing Mochi into pieces before consuming him

citation.text: "Hidetsugu", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Hidetsugu devours the failed oni, becomes the most formidable demonic entity, and is imprisoned in the spirit realm by Kyodai.
timeline.quote: His cruelties and the destruction he wreaked throughout the land caused Kyodai to personally intervene and imprison him in the spirit realm

citation.text: "Hidetsugu", section "After the War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kairi frees Hidetsugu from the spirit realm to help fight the Phyrexian Invasion; Hidetsugu agrees.
timeline.quote: Hidetsugu agreed to fight alongside the dragon.

citation.text: "Hidetsugu", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Hidetsugu and his yamabushi kill Keiga during their attack on the Minamo school.
timeline.quote: She was killed by Hidetsugu and his yamabushi minions during their attack on the school.

citation.text: "Kami", section "Dragon spirits". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At Minamo, Hidetsugu defeats Kiku bloodlessly; Marrow-Gnawer stabs his eye and the tile breaks, so the curse reclaims her.
timeline.quote: In the fall, the tile was broken and the curse claimed her again.

citation.text: "Kiku", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Toshi stops Kiku from killing Hidetsugu, invoking the hyozan curse on herself, then blinds the ogre.
timeline.quote: thus invoking the hyozan curse upon herself

citation.text: "Kiku", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Michiko and her party are at Minamo during Hidetsugu's attack and Toshi saves them.
timeline.quote: Once again, Toshi Umezawa saved her and her friends.

citation.text: "Michiko Konda", section "Kami War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Hidetsugu directs Toshi to the budoka monks, and Toshi leaves for Jukai with Kobo.
timeline.quote: So he leaves for the forest of Jukai with Hidetsugu's apprentice Kobo

citation.text: "Outlaw: Champions of Kamigawa", section "Part II". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Choryu lands in Shinka and Hidetsugu tortures him for Kobo's murder.
timeline.quote: he is there to answer for Kobo's murder

citation.text: "Outlaw: Champions of Kamigawa", section "Epilogue". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Toshi, sent with Uramon's hitmen to attack Hidetsugu, convinces the ogre to form the Hyozan Reckoners.
timeline.quote: The ogre killed all the others, but the kanji mage managed to convince him to form an allegiance that became known as the Hyozan Reckoners

citation.text: "Toshiro Umezawa", section "Early Years". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Toshi and Kobo set out for Jukai and defeat minions of the Myojin of Infinite Rage at Sokenzan.
timeline.quote: They crossed Sokenzan on their way, and successfully defeated the minions of the Myojin of Infinite Rage .

citation.text: "Toshiro Umezawa", section "The Kami War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Mochi shows Michiko her birth night; Toshi accepts Night's Reach's blessings and defeats Life's Web, then sends Choryu to Hidetsugu.
timeline.quote: Toshi was able to defeat Life's Web using his kanji magic that had been greatly enhanced by Night's Reach.

citation.text: "Toshiro Umezawa", section "The Kami War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Toshi defeats Chiyo and releases the oni-dog, which destroys much of Otawara.
timeline.quote: He fought and defeated Chiyo, then released Hidetsugu's oni-dog from the tile to destroy much of Otawara.

citation.text: "Toshiro Umezawa", section "The Kami War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Hidetsugu chokes Toshi and Kiku; Marrow-Gnawer stabs his eye and invokes the oath's wrath.
timeline.quote: Marrow-Gnawer managed to stab the ogre's eye, freeing Toshi and Kiku but invoking the wrath of the oath upon himself.

citation.text: "Toshiro Umezawa", section "The Kami War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Toshi stabs Hidetsugu through the remaining eye; the All-Consuming and O-Kagachi clash and Hidetsugu is changed.
timeline.quote: Hidetsugu prevailed in the end, but Toshi used his victory gesture to stab him through the remaining eye from a shadow cast by Kiku's body.

citation.text: "Toshiro Umezawa", section "The Kami War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kyodai turns Konda to stone and shatters him; Hidetsugu emerges merged with the oni and Mochi is eaten.
timeline.quote: Mochi was torn apart and eaten by the oni's jaws.

citation.text: "Toshiro Umezawa", section "The Kami War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: Formed the Hyozan Reckoners, later declared war.
relations.quote: persuaded him to form a new reckoner gang

citation.text: "Hidetsugu", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: Reincarnation of the dragon he slew; allied for now.
relations.quote: Kairi will seize the opportunity to lock him up once again

citation.text: "Hidetsugu", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: Imprisoned him in the spirit realm.
relations.quote: imprison him in the spirit realm
